quality_audit.finding: Loss of fine detail across successive generative revisions and source/display resolution; previous export was pixel-identical, not JPEG compression.
quality_audit.restoration_attempt: Requested 3072x2048; tool returned 1536x1024. Candidate v19 not integrated because no resolution gain and less faithful strap texture.
quality_audit.remaining_limit: Base scene stays1536x1024; native-resolution local character and background layers supply restored detail. Browser visual verification unavailable after origin permission was declined; local composition and production checks performed.
quality_audit.character_restoration: Two native-resolution local photographic restorations from lossless crops of v18 PNG, with earliest v1 photographic detail as benchmark; feathered CSS image layers preserve base product pixels and exact vector branding. See docs/CHARACTER_DETAIL_RESTORATION.md.
quality_audit.background_restoration: Independent native-detail background tiles for fixtures, clock, green/gold panelling, artwork, station architecture and marble; product excluded by simple alpha coverage. Open arched service window and matching lamp-switch pose. See docs/STATION_BACKGROUND_RESTORATION.md.

interaction_rules.straw: Two still positions only: Flat initial and Up final reference. Flat/Up switch. No animation, interpolation, automatic folding, playback, hold or Reset; fixed camera.
interaction_rules.spout: Static explanation and Tilt to drink. No playback, hold or Reset.
interaction_rules.mist: Momentary Press to mist. action: one500ms press/return pump per click, one finite140ms emission window, Dense white plume with650 fine droplets and soft edges matching the main-page spray; finite pulse travels outward toward the03Spray label after release and fade; no continuous emission, toggle/Stop, hold or Reset. Compact phone rectangle clear of hood with extra invisible tap area.
interaction_rules.main_callouts: Right column3/4/6 moved to65% width, leaders retargeted, clear of boy face. Panels flip and clamp within16px viewport margins, updating on resize and scroll.
interaction_rules.outlet_controls: Flat/Up immediately above Straw label; Press to mist. immediately above Spray label; no dotted/shaded outlet halo. Flat/Up match Press to mist. compact height, type and padding; natural text widths.
